Workload mix: chat-first (support), periodic embedding-based product search updates (nightly), occasional reranking for recommendations.
Traffic profile: low steady traffic (dozens/min), large spikes during promos (5-8x).
Latency SLO: soft 300-600ms; more sensitive on UI interactive flows (aim <400ms for common paths).
Throughput: modest — single-node throughput ok; cares more about per-token cost on spike days.
Model preference: small/quantized open models where possible; fallback to higher-cap models only for tough queries.
Routing/fallbacks: prefer auto-fallback to smaller model when latency spiking; want policy examples.
Cost sensitivity: high (SMB budget) — priority asks: batching, prefix/KV caching, prompt compression, token auditing + alerting.
Security/compliance: SSO/SAML + audit logs required; data residency not required at this stage.
Conversion signal: clear token savings in 2-3 week POC -> likely paid monthly hosted plan.
